_rules: All tools are MIT-licensed, public, and run their tests in CI. Test counts are exact; do not round or change them.

tools.name: decision-matrix
tools.description: A guided, in-browser decision matrix. Must-haves stay apart from weights, every score needs evidence, sensitivity analysis flags fragile decisions, and it writes a decision record you can commit.

image.alt: decision-matrix results: ranked options with a sensitivity warning on a fragile decision

tools.name: phasegate
tools.tagline: CI that catches the project phases teams skip.
tools.description: A CLI and GitHub Action that walks a project through seven phases, from discover to operate, and fails CI when a phase the team has moved past is not really done.

image.alt: phasegate status output for a project that skipped part of its requirements phase

tools.name: django-postmortem
tools.tagline: Blameless incident reviews that stop repeat failures.
tools.description: A Django app where blame-shaped wording is flagged, every action item must name the guard that stops the failure returning, and a review cannot close until someone has checked that guard works.

image.alt: django-postmortem review form with blameless-language and guard warnings

tools.name: vue-rtl-kit
tools.tagline: Right-to-left done properly for Vue 3 and Nuxt.
tools.description: Direction state that survives server-side rendering, logical-property utilities, and a BidiText component that isolates only the runs that would move, so dates and IDs stop reversing inside Arabic.

image.alt: Before and after: the same strings rendered raw and through BidiText

tools.name: django-rtl-admin
tools.tagline: A properly bilingual, right-to-left Django admin.
tools.description: One app in INSTALLED_APPS: logical-property styling for the parts of the admin that stay mirrored wrong, isolated mixed-script values, Arabic-Indic digits and a language switcher.

image.alt: The same Django admin side by side in English and Arabic

tools.name: claude-account-switcher
tools.tagline: Keep working when one Claude Code account hits its limit.
tools.description: Switches to your next Claude Code account and carries the conversation across, in the terminal or VS Code.

image.alt: Terminal: one account hits its limit and work continues on the next

also.name: vue-intent
also.description: A Vue 3 adapter for intent-first, state-driven UIs with permission guards and navigation protection.
